d: The Indian stock market has made a remarkable comeback in November 2026, with Sensex and Nifty witnessing a massive rally, the Indian rupee strengthening against the US dollar, and foreign institutional investors (FIIs) returning to Indian equities after months of record outflows. But does a booming stock market mean everything is well with the Indian economy? In this episode of Kharcha Paani, we explain the reasons behind the market rally, the global anti-AI trade, falling crude oil prices, strong corporate earnings, and renewed foreign investment in banking and financial stocks.
